findings.explanation: You are required to perform additional unspecified services without extra pay, and there is no change-order mechanism to ensure you are compensated for extra work.
findings.suggested_change: The Consultant shall provide the services specified herein, and any additional services requested by the Company shall be subject to a mutually agreed written change order and additional compensation.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a small modification before signing: - The relevant clause requires performing additional unspecified services without extra pay and lacks a change-order mechanism, so please update this section to state that the Consultant shall provide the services specified herein, and any additional services requested by the Company shall be subject to a mutually agreed written change order and additional compensation. Best regards,
